headline: New 3 BHK homes in a part of the city where new homes are rare.
pitch: Assetz 22 & Crest sits off West of Chord Road, between Yeshwanthpur and Mahalakshmi Layout. It is a central western address with a working metro and railway terminal close by.

reasons.title: An address that already works
reasons.text: Yeshwanthpur has a working Green Line metro station and one of the city's main railway terminals. Nothing here depends on a future project.

reasons.title: More metro is approved nearby
reasons.text: The Orange Line (Kempapura to JP Nagar, 32.15 km, 22 stations) was approved by the Union Cabinet in August 2024 and passes Peenya.
reasons.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

reasons.title: New homes are rare here
reasons.text: This is a built-up part of the city. Large new projects are few, which is why buyers who want a central western address watch each launch.

upcoming.what: Orange Line metro (Kempapura to JP Nagar 4th Phase)
upcoming.status: 32.15 km, 22 stations. Approved by the Union Cabinet in August 2024; scheduled completion 2031.
upcoming.why: A western ring of metro that links Hebbal, Peenya and JP Nagar without going through the centre.
upcoming.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

upcoming.what: Pink Line metro (Kalena Agrahara to Nagawara)
upcoming.status: 21.25 km, 18 stations. The elevated Kalena Agrahara to S.G. Palya section opened on 14 November 2026. The underground section to Nagawara is expected around March to May 2027.
upcoming.why: Connects the Bannerghatta Road side to MG Road and on to Nagawara, where it meets the airport line.
upcoming.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

upcoming.status: 73 km ring road with a reported 2029 deadline.
upcoming.why: Takes through-traffic off the Outer Ring Road and shortens cross-city trips.

timelineSource: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026; Sattva Group market note, 2026. Government target dates can move.
band: Portal averages in a built-up area swing with the few homes listed each quarter. Judge this project against the new projects around it, not the street average.

area.name: Yeshwanthpur
area.source: Square Yards property rates page, read 26 Nov 2026. Asking prices from listings, not registered sale prices.

up: The Orange Line moving into construction
Few new projects in a built-up area
Demand from buyers who want to stay in the west of the city
Good metro and rail access today
down: Traffic around Yeshwanthpur and Tumkur Road
Older resale homes nearby at lower prices
